translations.literal: Registry managers were initially subordinate ninth grade.
translations.idiomatic: Registry managers were initially subordinate ninth grade.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十年定正八品。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year of Qianlong fixed at regular eighth grade.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 30 they were fixed at regular eighth grade.

sentences.zh: 各部同。

translations.literal: The same for all ministries.
translations.idiomatic: All ministries followed the same rule.

sentences.zh: 滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: Manchu and Han, one person each.
translations.idiomatic: One Manchu appointee and one Han appointee.

sentences.zh: 繕本筆帖式，十有二人。

translations.literal: Fair-copy clerk-scribes, twelve in number.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve clerk-scribes handled fair-copy work.

sentences.zh: 文選、考功、驗封、稽勳四清吏司：郎中，初制三品。

translations.literal: The four Personnel Bureaus of Selection, Performance Evaluation, Verification and Ennoblement, and Merits and Records: directors, initial regulation rank 3.
translations.idiomatic: The four Personnel Bureaus—Selection, Performance Evaluation, Verification and Ennoblement, and Merits and Records—each had a director, originally of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 順治十六年改五品，尋升四品。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi changed to rank 5, soon after raised to rank 4.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 the rank was lowered to the fifth grade, then soon raised to the fourth.

sentences.zh: 康熙六年仍改三品，九年定正五品。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Kangxi again changed to rank 3; in the ninth year fixed at regular rank 5.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 6 the rank reverted to the third grade; in Kangxi 9 it was fixed at the regular fifth.

sentences.zh: 各部同。

translations.literal: All ministries the same.
translations.idiomatic: The same arrangement applied in every ministry.

sentences.zh: 滿洲九人，文選四人，考功三人，驗封、稽勳司各一人。

translations.literal: Nine Manchus: four in Selection, three in Performance Evaluation, one each in Verification and Merits Bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: Nine Manchu directors: four in Selection, three in Performance Evaluation, and one each in Verification and Merits.

sentences.zh: 蒙古一人，文選司置。

translations.literal: One Mongol, placed in the Selection Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: One Mongol post, assigned to the Selection Bureau.

sentences.zh: 漢五人。

translations.literal: Han five persons.
translations.idiomatic: Five Han Chinese directors.

sentences.zh: 文選二人，餘各一人。

translations.literal: Selection two persons, the rest one each.
translations.idiomatic: Two in Selection; one in each of the other bureaus.

sentences.zh: 員外郎，初制四品。

translations.literal: Vice directors, initial regulation rank 4.
translations.idiomatic: Vice directors were originally of the fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 順治十六年改五品。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi changed to rank 5.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 they were reduced to the fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 康熙六年復故，九年定從五品。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Kangxi restored to former rule; in the ninth year fixed at subordinate rank 5.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 6 the former rank was restored; in Kangxi 9 they were fixed at the subordinate fifth.

sentences.zh: 各部同。

translations.literal: All ministries the same.
translations.idiomatic: The same rule held in all ministries.

sentences.zh: 宗室一人，稽勳司置。

translations.literal: One from the imperial clan, placed in the Merits Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: One imperial clansman, posted to the Merits Bureau.

sentences.zh: 滿洲八人，文選三人，考功、驗封各二人，稽勳一人。

translations.literal: Eight Manchus: three Selection, two each Performance Evaluation and Verification, one Merits.
translations.idiomatic: Eight Manchu vice directors: three in Selection, two each in Performance Evaluation and Verification, and one in Merits.

sentences.zh: 蒙古一人，考功司置。

translations.literal: One Mongol, placed in the Performance Evaluation Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: One Mongol post, assigned to Performance Evaluation.

sentences.zh: 漢六人。

translations.literal: Han six persons.
translations.idiomatic: Six Han Chinese vice directors.

sentences.zh: 文選三人，餘各一人。

translations.literal: Selection three persons, the rest one each.
translations.idiomatic: Three in Selection; one in each of the others.

sentences.zh: 主事，宗室一人，稽勳司置。

translations.literal: Secretaries: one from the imperial clan, placed in the Merits Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Among secretaries, one imperial clansman was posted to the Merits Bureau.

sentences.zh: 滿洲四人，司各一人。

translations.literal: Four Manchus, one per bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Four Manchu secretaries, one in each bureau.

sentences.zh: 蒙古一人，驗封司置。

translations.literal: One Mongol, placed in the Verification Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: One Mongol secretary in the Verification Bureau.

sentences.zh: 漢七人。

translations.literal: Han seven persons.
translations.idiomatic: Seven Han Chinese secretaries.

sentences.zh: 文選三人，考功二人，餘各一人。

translations.literal: Selection three persons, Performance Evaluation two, the rest one each.
translations.idiomatic: Three in Selection, two in Performance Evaluation, and one in each of the remaining bureaus.

sentences.zh: 筆帖式，宗室一人，滿洲五十有七人，蒙古四人，漢軍十有二人。

translations.literal: Clerk-scribes: one imperial clansman, fifty-seven Manchus, four Mongols, twelve Han Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Clerk-scribes numbered one clansman, fifty-seven Manchus, four Mongols, and twelve Han Banner men.

sentences.zh: 學習行走者，有額外司員、七品小京官。

translations.literal: Trainees on probation included extra bureau officers and seventh-rank junior capital officials.
translations.idiomatic: Probationary trainees included supplemental bureau officers and seventh-rank junior capital officials.

sentences.zh: 各部同。

translations.literal: All ministries the same.
translations.idiomatic: Other ministries followed the same pattern.

sentences.zh: 尚書掌銓綜衡軸，以布邦職。

translations.literal: The minister controlled comprehensive selection and the pivot of the balance, to deploy state offices.
translations.idiomatic: The minister oversaw the whole apparatus of appointment and the central pivot of selection, assigning offices across the realm.

sentences.zh: 侍郎貳之。

translations.literal: Vice ministers assisted.
translations.idiomatic: Vice ministers assisted him.

sentences.zh: 堂主事掌文案章奏。

translations.literal: Hall secretaries managed documents and memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Hall secretaries handled drafts and memorials.

sentences.zh: 司務掌出納文移。

translations.literal: Office managers controlled receipt and dispatch of paperwork.
translations.idiomatic: Office managers managed the flow of incoming and outgoing documents.

sentences.zh: 以上二員各部同。

translations.literal: The above two posts were the same in all ministries.
translations.idiomatic: These two posts were organized the same way in every ministry.

sentences.zh: 文選掌班秩遷除，平均銓法。

translations.literal: Selection managed rank rotation and transfers, balancing selection law.
translations.idiomatic: The Selection Bureau regulated promotions and transfers and kept the rules of appointment even-handed.

sentences.zh: 官分九品，各系正從，級十有八，不及九品曰未入流。

translations.literal: Offices divided into nine ranks, each tied to regular and subordinate grades, eighteen steps in all; below rank nine was called outside the regular stream.
translations.idiomatic: Official ranks ran from one to nine, each with regular and subordinate grades for eighteen steps in all; posts below the ninth rank were classed as outside the regular stream.

sentences.zh: 選人並登資簿，依流平進，踵故牒序遷之。

translations.literal: Candidates were all entered in qualification registers, advanced according to the regular stream and seniority, following former documents in ordered promotion.
translations.idiomatic: Every candidate was entered on the qualification rolls and advanced by seniority within the regular stream, promotions following the sequence of prior appointments.

sentences.zh: 考功掌考課，三載考績。

translations.literal: Performance Evaluation managed examinations; triennial performance review.
translations.idiomatic: The Performance Evaluation Bureau conducted assessments, including the triennial review of service.

sentences.zh: 京察、大計各聽察於長官，著跡計簿。

translations.literal: Metropolitan review and grand assessment were each inspected by superiors, recorded in merit registers.
translations.idiomatic: Metropolitan review and the grand assessment were each conducted by superiors and entered in performance registers.

sentences.zh: 凡論劾、釋免、引年、稱疾，並覈功過處分。

translations.literal: All impeachment, release from office, retirement by age, and pleas of illness were assessed for merit and fault and punished accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Impeachments, dismissals, retirements on age, and claims of illness were all weighed for merit and fault and punished as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 交議者，辨公私輕重，條議以聞。

translations.literal: Cases referred for deliberation: distinguish public and private, lighter and heavier, set out proposals and report.
translations.idiomatic: Matters sent for joint deliberation were sorted by public and private interest and by severity, then drafted into proposals for the throne.

sentences.zh: 稽勳掌勳級、名籍、喪養，兼稽京朝官廩祿，稽俸□隸之。

translations.literal: Merits and Records managed merit grades, name registers, and mourning support, and also audited grain salaries of capital officials; it audited salaries and — of subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: The Merits Bureau kept merit grades, name registers, and mourning provisions, audited stipends and grain for capital officials, and oversaw subordinate pay and ration accounts.

sentences.zh: 漢司官員數，八旗世職繼襲。

translations.literal: Han bureau staffing numbers; Eight Banner hereditary offices and succession.
translations.idiomatic: It also tracked Han bureau staffing and the inheritance of hereditary Eight Banner posts.

sentences.zh: 驗封掌廕敘、正一品子正五品敘，從一品子從五品敘，其下以是為差。

translations.literal: Verification managed yin privileges and enfeoffment grades: a regular first-rank son received regular fifth-rank appointment, a subordinate first-rank son subordinate fifth-rank appointment, and so on by gradation below.
translations.idiomatic: The Verification Bureau handled yin privileges and enfeoffment: sons of regular first-rank fathers received regular fifth-rank appointments, sons of subordinate first-rank fathers subordinate fifth-rank appointments, with lower ranks graded in proportion.

sentences.zh: 封贈、階十有八：正一品授光祿大夫，從一品授榮祿大夫，正二品授資政大夫，從二品授奉政大夫，正三品授通議大夫，從三品授中議大夫，正四品授中憲大夫，從四品授朝議大夫，正五品授奉政大夫，從五品授奉直大夫，俱授誥命。

translations.literal: Enfeoffment grants and eighteen honorary ranks: regular first rank received Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, subordinate first rank Illustrious Grand Master, regular second rank Grand Master of Governance, subordinate second rank Grand Master of Court Administration, regular third rank Grand Master of Comprehensive Discussion, subordinate third rank Grand Master of Court Discussion, regular fourth rank Grand Master of Court Rectitude, subordinate fourth rank Grand Master of Court Deliberation, regular fifth rank Grand Master of Court Administration, subordinate fifth rank Grand Master of Direct Court Administration—all granted patent edicts of appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Enfeoffment and eighteen honorary titles ran from the regular first rank, which received the title Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, down through the subordinate fifth rank as Grand Master of Direct Court Administration; all received patent edicts of appointment.

sentences.zh: 正六品授承德郎，從六品授儒林郎，吏員出身者宣德郎，正七品授文林郎，吏員出身者宣義郎，從七品授徵仕郎，正八品授修職郎，從八品授修職佐郎，正九品授登仕郎，從九品授登仕佐郎，俱授敕命。

translations.literal: Regular sixth rank received Gentleman of Continued Merit, subordinate sixth rank Gentleman of the Forest of Scholars, clerical-origin holders Gentleman of Propagating Virtue; regular seventh rank Gentleman of Literary Forest, clerical-origin Gentleman of Propagating Righteousness; subordinate seventh rank Gentleman Summoned to Office; regular eighth rank Gentleman of Cultivated Office; subordinate eighth Associate Gentleman of Cultivated Office; regular ninth Gentleman of Ascending Office; subordinate ninth Associate Gentleman of Ascending Office—all granted edicts of appointment.
translations.idiomatic: From the regular sixth rank as Gentleman of Continued Merit through the subordinate ninth as Associate Gentleman of Ascending Office, including separate titles for clerical-origin holders, all received edicts of appointment.

sentences.zh: 命婦之號九：一曰一品夫人，二品亦曰夫人，三品曰淑人，四品曰恭人，五品曰宜人，六品曰安人，七品曰孺人，八品曰八品孺人，九品曰九品孺人，不分正從。

translations.literal: Titles for titled wives numbered nine: first, Lady of the First Rank; second rank also Lady; third rank Shuren; fourth Gongren; fifth Yiren; sixth Anren; seventh Ruren; eighth Eighth-Rank Ruren; ninth Ninth-Rank Ruren—without distinction of regular and subordinate grades.
translations.idiomatic: Nine titles honored officials' wives: Lady of the First Rank, Lady for the second rank, Shuren for the third, Gongren for the fourth, Yiren for the fifth, Anren for the sixth, Ruren for the seventh, and eighth- and ninth-rank Ruren for the lowest grades, without distinguishing regular from subordinate ranks.

sentences.zh: 因其子孫封者加「太」字，夫在則否。

translations.literal: When enfeoffment came through descendants, the prefix "Grand" was added; if the husband still lived, it was not.
translations.idiomatic: Honors granted through descendants took the prefix "Grand"; if the husband was still alive, they did not.

sentences.zh: 一品封贈三代，二、三品二代，四品至七品一代，以下止封本身。

translations.literal: First rank enfeoffed three generations; second and third ranks two generations; fourth through seventh ranks one generation; below that only the person himself was enfeoffed.
translations.idiomatic: First-rank honors could reach back three generations; second and third ranks two; fourth through seventh one; below that only the living official was honored.

sentences.zh: 一品四軸用玉，二品三軸用犀，三品三軸、四品二軸用抹金，五品以下二軸用角。

translations.literal: First rank: four scrolls with jade; second rank three scrolls with rhinoceros horn; third rank three scrolls and fourth rank two scrolls with gilt; fifth rank and below two scrolls with horn.
translations.idiomatic: Patent scrolls for the first rank used four jade-mounted rolls; the second rank three rhinoceros-horn rolls; the third three and the fourth two gilt rolls; fifth rank and below two horn rolls.

sentences.zh: 凡嫡母在，生母不得並封。

translations.literal: Whenever the legal mother was alive, the birth mother could not be enfeoffed together.
translations.idiomatic: If the legal mother was still living, the birth mother could not receive a concurrent enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 又兩子當封，從其品大者。

translations.literal: Again, when two sons were eligible for enfeoffment, follow whichever rank was higher.
translations.idiomatic: When two sons could confer honors, the higher of their ranks governed.

sentences.zh: 酬庸、獎忠。

translations.literal: Rewarding merit and encouraging loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: It rewarded distinguished service and encouraged loyal conduct.

sentences.zh: 覈贈、廕死難官員，有贈、有廕。

translations.literal: Verified posthumous grants and yin for officials who died in service: some received grants, some received yin.
translations.idiomatic: It verified posthumous honors and yin privileges for officials who died in the line of duty, granting either enfeoffment or hereditary privilege as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 當否。

translations.literal: Whether appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: It ruled on whether each case was warranted.

sentences.zh: 襲封則辨分合，別宗支等。

translations.literal: For hereditary enfeoffment, distinguish division and consolidation, separate lineage branches and grades.
translations.idiomatic: For inherited titles it distinguished partitions and reunions and sorted lineage branches and grades.

sentences.zh: 其世流降除，勘土官世職，移文選司注擬。

translations.literal: Their generational descent, reduction, and removal; investigation of native-official hereditary posts; referral to the Selection Bureau for proposed appointment.
translations.idiomatic: It tracked generational demotion and removal, examined hereditary native-official posts, and referred nominations to the Selection Bureau.

sentences.zh: 推恩外戚，加榮聖裔，優恤勝國，並按典奏聞。

translations.literal: Extending grace to maternal kin, adding glory to sage descendants, showing preferential care to the former dynasty—all reported according to statute.
translations.idiomatic: Extensions of favor to maternal kin, honors to sage descendants, and preferential treatment of the former dynasty were all memorialized according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 別設督催所，趣各司交議事，督以例限。

translations.literal: A separate Supervision and Urging Office was established to press each bureau on matters sent for deliberation and enforce statutory deadlines.
translations.idiomatic: A separate office urged bureaus to complete deliberative cases within the legal time limits.

sentences.zh: 當月處，主受事、付事，兼監堂印。

translations.literal: The monthly duty section managed receipt and dispatch of business and also supervised the hall seal.
translations.idiomatic: The monthly rotation handled incoming and outgoing papers and guarded the ministry seal.

sentences.zh: 遴司員分司之。

translations.literal: Bureau officers were selected and assigned by rotation.
translations.idiomatic: Bureau officers were chosen and assigned in turn.

sentences.zh: 各部同。

translations.literal: All ministries the same.
translations.idiomatic: Every ministry followed the same practice.

sentences.zh: 初，天聰五年，詔群僚議定官制，建六部，各以貝勒一人領之。

translations.literal: At the beginning, in the fifth year of Tiancong, an edict ordered the assembled officials to deliberate and fix the official system; six ministries were established, each led by one beile.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Tiancong 5 the court ordered officials to settle the bureaucracy, founded the six ministries, and placed a beile at the head of each.

sentences.zh: 順治元年罷。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi abolished.
translations.idiomatic: This arrangement was abolished in Shunzhi 1.

sentences.zh: 八年復以親王、郡王兼攝，九年罷。

translations.literal: In the eighth year restored with princes and commandery princes concurrently holding the posts; in the ninth year abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 8 princes and commandery princes again held the ministries concurrently; in Shunzhi 9 the practice ended.

sentences.zh: 置承政四人，滿二人，蒙、漢各一人。

translations.literal: Four cheng-political directors were established: two Manchu, one Mongol, one Han.
translations.idiomatic: Four cheng-political directors were appointed—two Manchus, one Mongol, and one Han.

sentences.zh: 唯工部滿一人，漢二人。

translations.literal: Only the Ministry of Works had one Manchu and two Han.
translations.idiomatic: Only Works had one Manchu and two Han directors.

sentences.zh: 參政八人，唯工部置蒙、漢各二人。

translations.literal: Eight can-political vice directors; only Works placed two Mongols and two Han.
translations.idiomatic: There were eight can-political vice directors; Works alone had two Mongol and two Han posts.

sentences.zh: 共十有二人。

translations.literal: Twelve in all.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve posts in all.

sentences.zh: 啟心郎一人。

translations.literal: One qixinlang (advising) officer.
translations.idiomatic: One qixinlang adviser was appointed.

sentences.zh: 工部置漢二人。

translations.literal: Works placed two Han.
translations.idiomatic: Works had two Han advisers.

sentences.zh: 順治九年定秩視侍郎。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Shunzhi the rank was fixed equivalent to vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 9 their rank was set equal to that of a vice minister.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，六部定承政一人，左參政二人，右參政三人，戶部四人。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongde the six ministries fixed one cheng-political director, two left can-political vice directors, three right can-political vice directors; Revenue four.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 3 each ministry had one cheng-political director, two left and three right can-political vice directors, with Revenue having four of the latter.

sentences.zh: 啟心郎三人，滿一人，漢二人。

translations.literal: Three qixinlang advisers: one Manchu, two Han.
translations.idiomatic: Three qixinlang advisers were set—one Manchu and two Han.

sentences.zh: 理事官四十有三人，吏、禮二部各四人，戶、兵二部各十人，刑部六人，工部九人。

translations.literal: Forty-three managing officers: Personnel and Rites four each; Revenue and War ten each; Justice six; Works nine.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-three managing officers were assigned: four each to Personnel and Rites, ten each to Revenue and War, six to Justice, and nine to Works.

sentences.zh: 副理事官六十有五人，吏部六人，戶、兵二部各十有六人，禮部七人，刑部八人，工部十有二人。

translations.literal: Fifty-five deputy managing officers: Personnel six; Revenue and War sixteen each; Rites seven; Justice eight; Works twelve.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty-five deputy managing officers followed: six in Personnel, sixteen each in Revenue and War, seven in Rites, eight in Justice, and twelve in Works.

sentences.zh: 額哲庫二人。

translations.literal: Two ejekeku clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Two ejekeku clerks were authorized.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，改承政為尚書，參政為侍郎，理事官為郎中，副理事官為員外郎，額哲庫為主事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, cheng-political directors were changed to ministers, can-political vice directors to vice ministers, managing officers to directors, deputy managing officers to vice directors, and ejeke clerks to secretaries.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 cheng-political directors became ministers, can-political posts vice ministers, managing officers directors, deputy managers vice directors, and ejeke clerks secretaries.

sentences.zh: 初置增減無恆。

translations.literal: At first appointments increased and decreased without fixed rule.
translations.idiomatic: At first staffing rose and fell without fixed quotas.

sentences.zh: 時滿洲尚書，滿、漢左、右侍郎，亦無員限。

translations.literal: At that time Manchu ministers and Manchu and Han left and right vice ministers likewise had no fixed quotas.
translations.idiomatic: Manchu ministers and Manchu and Han left and right vice ministers likewise had no fixed numbers.

sentences.zh: 漢右侍郎兼翰林院學士銜。

translations.literal: The Han right vice minister concurrently held the Hanlin Academy academician title.
translations.idiomatic: The Han right vice minister also carried the Hanlin academician title.

sentences.zh: 非翰林出身者不兼。

translations.literal: Those not of Hanlin origin did not hold the concurrent post.
translations.idiomatic: Only Hanlin graduates could hold the concurrent title.

sentences.zh: 尋罷。

translations.literal: Soon after abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The practice was soon dropped.

sentences.zh: 本部郎中，滿洲四人，十二年增四人。

translations.literal: Directors in this ministry: four Manchus; in the twelfth year four more added.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry had four Manchu directors; four more were added in year 12.

sentences.zh: 光緒十三年增文選一人。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Guangxu one more was added to Selection.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 13 one more director was added to Selection.

sentences.zh: 漢軍二人，雍正五年省。

translations.literal: Two Han Banner posts; eliminated in the fifth year of Yongzheng.
translations.idiomatic: Two Han Banner posts were cut in Yongzheng 5.

sentences.zh: 滿、蒙員外郎八人，十二年省蒙古缺。

translations.literal: Eight Manchu and Mongol vice directors; in the twelfth year the Mongol posts were cut.
translations.idiomatic: Eight Manchu and Mongol vice directors were authorized; the Mongol quota was removed in year 12.

sentences.zh: 十八年復置蒙古八人，康熙元年省，五十七年復置一人。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year eight Mongol posts were restored; cut in the first year of Kangxi; in the fifty-seventh year one was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Eight Mongol vice directors were restored in year 18, abolished in Kangxi 1, and one Mongol post returned in Kangxi 57.

sentences.zh: 漢軍六人。

translations.literal: Six Han Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Six Han Banner vice directors.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十八年省四人。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year of Kangxi four posts were cut.
translations.idiomatic: Four posts were eliminated in Kangxi 38.

sentences.zh: 雍正五年並省。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng all were cut.
translations.idiomatic: All remaining Han Banner posts were abolished in Yongzheng 5.

sentences.zh: 滿洲堂主事、清文、清漢文各二人。

translations.literal: Manchu hall secretaries: two each for Manchu-script and Manchu-Chinese-script sections.
translations.idiomatic: Manchu hall secretaries numbered two each for pure Manchu and Manchu-Chinese documentation.

sentences.zh: 司主事光緒十三年增文選一人。

translations.literal: Bureau secretaries: in the thirteenth year of Guangxu one added to Selection.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 13 one bureau secretary was added to Selection.

sentences.zh: 各四人，漢軍一人，漢司務二人。

translations.literal: Four each; one Han Banner; two Han office managers.
translations.idiomatic: There were four in each category, one Han Banner secretary, and two Han office managers.

sentences.zh: 四年省一人。

translations.literal: In the fourth year one post was cut.
translations.idiomatic: One post was cut in year 4.

sentences.zh: 十五年定滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year fixed at one Manchu and one Han each.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15 the quota was fixed at one Manchu and one Han each.

sentences.zh: 各部同。

translations.literal: All ministries the same.
translations.idiomatic: Other ministries followed the same rule.

sentences.zh: 文選司，漢郎中、員外郎各一人，雍正五年增員外郎一人。

translations.literal: Selection Bureau: one Han director and one Han vice director; in the fifth year of Yongzheng one more vice director added.
translations.idiomatic: The Selection Bureau had one Han director and one Han vice director; Yongzheng 5 added another Han vice director.

sentences.zh: 光緒十三年各增一人。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Guangxu one more added to each.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 13 one more Han director and vice director were added to each post.

sentences.zh: 主事二人。

translations.literal: Secretaries, two persons.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau had two secretaries.

sentences.zh: 光緒十三年增一人。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Guangxu one more added.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxu 13 added one more secretary.

sentences.zh: 考功、稽勳、驗封三司，漢郎中、員外郎、主事各一人。

translations.literal: The three bureaus of Performance Evaluation, Merits and Records, and Verification: one Han director, vice director, and secretary each.
translations.idiomatic: Performance Evaluation, Merits and Records, and Verification each had one Han director, vice director, and secretary.

sentences.zh: 雍正五年增考功主事一人。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng one secretary was added to the Performance Evaluation Section.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5 one secretary was added to the Performance Evaluation Section.

sentences.zh: 並置筆帖式，分隸堂司。

translations.literal: Clerks were also established, assigned separately to the hall and sections.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks were also appointed and assigned to the hall and to the sections.

sentences.zh: 各部同。

translations.literal: The same for all ministries.
translations.idiomatic: All ministries followed the same rule.

sentences.zh: 五年，定滿、漢尚書各一人。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, one Manchu and one Han minister each were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year one Manchu and one Han minister each were appointed.

sentences.zh: 七年增滿洲一人，十年省。

translations.literal: In the seventh year one Manchu post was added; in the tenth year it was cut.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year one Manchu post was added; in the tenth it was abolished.

sentences.zh: 十五年，省啟心郎，定滿、漢左、右侍郎各一人。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year the qixinlang advisor posts were abolished, and one Manchu and one Han left and right vice minister each were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year the advisor posts were abolished and one Manchu and one Han left and right vice minister each were appointed.

sentences.zh: 康熙五十七年，增置蒙古郎中、主事各一人。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year of Kangxi one Mongolian director and one secretary each were added.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 57 one Mongolian director and one secretary were added.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，以大學士領部事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng a grand secretary headed the ministry.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 a grand secretary headed the ministry.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，更命親王綜之，尋罷。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing a prince was again ordered to oversee it, soon removed.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4 a prince was again ordered to oversee the ministry, then soon removed.

sentences.zh: 改滿洲員外郎、主事各一人為宗室員缺。

translations.literal: One Manchu vice director and one secretary each were changed to Imperial Clan quota posts.
translations.idiomatic: One Manchu vice director and one secretary each became Imperial Clan quota posts.

sentences.zh: 六年，復以大學士管部，自是為定制。

translations.literal: In the sixth year grand secretaries again managed the ministry; thereafter this became the fixed rule.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year grand secretaries again managed the ministry, and this became standard practice.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十三年，澄汰書吏，增文選、考功二司郎中、員外郎、主事各一人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Guangxu clerical staff were purged, and one director, vice director, and secretary each were added to the Appointment and Performance Evaluation sections.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 23 clerks were purged and the Appointment and Performance Evaluation sections each gained one director, vice director, and secretary.

sentences.zh: 滿、漢參用。

translations.literal: Manchu and Han were used jointly.
translations.idiomatic: Manchu and Han appointees were used jointly.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，定尚書，左、右侍郎，左、右丞、參各一人。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year one minister, one left and right vice minister, and one left and right vice director and counsellor each were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year the ministry was fixed at one minister, one left and one right vice minister, and one left and one right vice director and counsellor each.

sentences.zh: 丞、參品秩，詳新官制外務部。

translations.literal: The ranks of vice directors and counsellors are detailed under the new official system of the Foreign Affairs Ministry.
translations.idiomatic: Vice director and counsellor ranks are set out in the new official system of the Foreign Affairs Ministry.

sentences.zh: 初制，滿、蒙、漢軍司官，六部統為員額，不置專曹，後始分司定秩如漢人。

translations.literal: In the initial system, Manchu, Mongol, and Han Banner section officials were pooled in a single quota for the Six Ministries without separate bureaus; only later were sections established with ranks fixed like those of Han officials.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Manchu, Mongol, and Han Banner section staff shared ministry-wide quotas without separate bureaus; only later were bureaus created with Han-style ranks.

sentences.zh: 季世詔泯滿、漢畛域，各部復參用矣。

translations.literal: In the dynasty’s last years an edict erased Manchu–Han boundaries, and all ministries again used appointees jointly.
translations.idiomatic: In the dynasty’s closing years an edict erased Manchu–Han boundaries and ministries again appointed both jointly.

sentences.zh: 吏部班次曩居六部上。

translations.literal: The Board of Personnel had long ranked above the other ministries.
translations.idiomatic: The Board of Personnel had long ranked first among the Six Ministries.

sentences.zh: 各司郎官，非科甲出身者，不得注授。

translations.literal: Section directors and vice directors who were not jinshi degree-holders could not receive appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Section directors and vice directors had to be jinshi degree-holders.

sentences.zh: 禮部、宗人府、起居注主事同。

translations.literal: The same rule applied to the Board of Rites, the Imperial Clan Court, and secretaries of the Daily Records.
translations.idiomatic: The same rule applied in the Board of Rites, the Imperial Clan Court, and the Daily Records office.

sentences.zh: 自外務部設，班位稍爽，改組內閣，設銓敘、制誥等局，吏部遂廢。

translations.literal: Once the Foreign Affairs Ministry was established, precedence shifted somewhat; when the Grand Secretariat was reorganized and appointment confirmation and edict drafting bureaus were set up, the Board of Personnel was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: After the Foreign Affairs Ministry was set up, precedence shifted; reorganization of the Grand Secretariat with appointment and edict bureaus led to abolition of the Board of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 戶部尚書，左、右侍郎，俱滿、漢一人。

translations.literal: The Board of Revenue had one minister and one left and right vice minister each, one Manchu and one Han.
translations.idiomatic: The Board of Revenue had one Manchu and one Han minister and one Manchu and one Han left and right vice minister each.

sentences.zh: 其屬：堂主事，南檔房滿洲二人，北檔房滿洲、漢軍各二人。

translations.literal: Subordinates: hall secretaries—two Manchus in the southern archive office, two Manchus and two Han Bannermen in the northern archive office.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinates included hall secretaries: two Manchus in the southern archive and two Manchus and two Han Bannermen in the northern archive.

sentences.zh: 司務□司務，滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: Registry managers, one Manchu and one Han each.
translations.idiomatic: Registry managers: one Manchu and one Han each.

sentences.zh: 繕本筆帖式二十人。

translations.literal: Twenty clerks for fair-copy drafts.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty fair-copy clerks served.

sentences.zh: 江南、江西、浙江、湖廣、福建、山東、山西、河南、陝西、四川、廣東、廣西、雲南、貴州十四清吏司：郎中，宗室一人，江西司置。

translations.literal: Fourteen clearance sections—for Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Huguang, Fujian, Shandong, Shanxi, Henan, Shaanxi, Sichuan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Yunnan, and Guizhou: one Imperial Clan director, placed in the Jiangxi section.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen clearance sections for Jiangnan through Guizhou: one Imperial Clan director, in the Jiangxi section.

sentences.zh: 滿洲十有七人，江南、浙江、河南、山西、陝西、四川、廣東、廣西、貴州司各一人，福建、湖廣、山東、雲南司各二人。

translations.literal: Seventeen Manchu directors—one each in the Jiangnan, Zhejiang, Henan, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Sichuan, Guangdong, Guangxi, and Guizhou sections, two each in the Fujian, Huguang, Shandong, and Yunnan sections.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeen Manchu directors: one each in nine sections and two each in Fujian, Huguang, Shandong, and Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 蒙古一人，山西司置。

translations.literal: One Mongolian director, in the Shanxi section.
translations.idiomatic: One Mongolian director served in the Shanxi section.

sentences.zh: 漢十有四人。

translations.literal: Fourteen Han directors.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen Han directors served.

sentences.zh: 司各一人。

translations.literal: One per section.
translations.idiomatic: Each section had one.

sentences.zh: 員外郎，宗室二人，廣東、廣西司置。

translations.literal: Vice directors: two Imperial Clan members, in the Guangdong and Guangxi sections.
translations.idiomatic: Vice directors: two Imperial Clan members, in Guangdong and Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 滿洲三十有六人，山西司一人，浙江、江西、河南、四川、廣東、湖廣司各二人，江南、陝西、廣西、山東、雲南、貴州司各三人，福建司五人。

translations.literal: Thirty-six Manchu vice directors—one in Shanxi, two each in Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Henan, Sichuan, Guangdong, and Huguang, three each in Jiangnan, Shaanxi, Guangxi, Shandong, Yunnan, and Guizhou, five in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-six Manchu vice directors: one in Shanxi, two in six sections, three in six sections, and five in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 漢十有四人。

translations.literal: Fourteen Han vice directors.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen Han vice directors served.

sentences.zh: 主事，宗室一人，浙江司置。

translations.literal: Secretaries: one Imperial Clan member, in the Zhejiang section.
translations.idiomatic: Secretaries: one Imperial Clan member in the Zhejiang section.

sentences.zh: 蒙古一人，福建司置。

translations.literal: One Mongolian secretary, in the Fujian section.
translations.idiomatic: One Mongolian secretary served in the Fujian section.

sentences.zh: 滿、漢各十有四人。

translations.literal: Fourteen Manchu and fourteen Han each.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen Manchu and fourteen Han secretaries each.

sentences.zh: 筆帖式，宗室一人，滿洲百人，蒙古四人，漢軍十有六人。

translations.literal: Clerks: one Imperial Clan member, one hundred Manchus, four Mongols, sixteen Han Bannermen.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks: one Imperial Clan member, one hundred Manchus, four Mongols, and sixteen Han Bannermen.

sentences.zh: 尚書掌軍國支計，以足邦用。

translations.literal: The minister managed state revenue and expenditure to supply the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The minister managed national revenue and expenditure to meet state needs.

sentences.zh: 侍郎貳之。

translations.literal: Vice ministers assisted.
translations.idiomatic: Vice ministers assisted him.

sentences.zh: 右侍郎兼掌寶泉局鼓鑄。

translations.literal: The right vice minister also directed coinage at the Baoquan Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: The right vice minister also oversaw minting at the Baoquan Bureau.

sentences.zh: 十四司，各掌其分省民賦，及八旗諸司稟祿，軍士饟糈，各倉，鹽課，鈔關，雜稅。

translations.literal: The fourteen sections each managed their provinces’ land tax, stipends for Eight Banner offices, soldiers’ grain pay, granaries, salt revenue, transit duties, and miscellaneous taxes.
translations.idiomatic: The fourteen sections each handled their provinces’ land tax, Banner stipends, troop grain pay, granaries, salt, transit duties, and miscellaneous taxes.

sentences.zh: 江南司兼稽江寧、蘇州織造支銷，江寧、京口駐防俸餉，各省平餘地丁逾限未結者。

translations.literal: The Jiangnan section also scrutinized weaving-office accounts at Nanjing and Suzhou, garrison pay at Nanjing and Jingkou, and overdue land-tax surcharges in the provinces.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangnan section also audited Nanjing and Suzhou weaving accounts, Nanjing and Jingkou garrison pay, and overdue provincial land-tax surcharges.

sentences.zh: 江西司兼稽各省協餉。

translations.literal: The Jiangxi section also scrutinized provincial cooperative subsidies.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangxi section also audited cooperative subsidies from the provinces.

sentences.zh: 浙江司兼稽杭州織造支銷，杭州、乍浦駐防俸餉，及各省民數、穀數。

translations.literal: The Zhejiang section also scrutinized Hangzhou weaving accounts, garrison pay at Hangzhou and Zhapu, and provincial population and grain figures.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhejiang section also audited Hangzhou weaving accounts, Hangzhou and Zhapu garrison pay, and provincial population and grain returns.

sentences.zh: 福建司兼稽直隸民賦，天津海稅，東西陵、熱河、密雲駐防俸餉，司乳牛牧馬政令，文武鄉會試支供，五城賑粟。

translations.literal: The Fujian section also scrutinized Zhili land tax, Tianjin maritime duties, garrison pay at the Eastern and Western Tombs, Rehe, and Miyun, dairy and horse policies, civil and military examination expenses, and grain relief in the five wards of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Fujian section also audited Zhili land tax, Tianjin maritime duties, tomb and frontier garrison pay, dairy and horse regulations, examination expenses, and capital grain relief.

sentences.zh: 湖廣司兼稽奉省廠課，荊州駐防俸餉，各省地丁耗羨之數。

translations.literal: The Huguang section also scrutinized factory levies in Fengtian, Jingzhou garrison pay, and provincial land-tax surcharges.
translations.idiomatic: The Huguang section also audited Fengtian factory levies, Jingzhou garrison pay, and provincial land-tax surcharges.

sentences.zh: 河南司兼稽開封駐防俸餉，察哈爾俸餉，及報銷未結者。

translations.literal: The Henan section also scrutinized Kaifeng and Chahar garrison pay and unsettled reimbursement accounts.
translations.idiomatic: The Henan section also audited Kaifeng and Chahar garrison pay and outstanding reimbursements.

sentences.zh: 山東司兼稽青州、德州駐防俸餉，東三省兵糈出納，參票畜稅，並察給八旗官養廉，長蘆等處鹽課。

translations.literal: The Shandong section also scrutinized Qingzhou and Dezhou garrison pay, grain disbursement in the three eastern provinces, ginseng-ticket and livestock taxes, stipends for incorruptibility to Banner officials, and salt revenue at Changlu and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: The Shandong section also audited Qingzhou and Dezhou garrison pay, northeastern troop grain, ginseng and livestock taxes, Banner integrity stipends, and Changlu salt revenue.

sentences.zh: 山西司兼稽遊牧察哈爾地畝，土默特地糧，喀爾喀、回部定邊左副將軍辦事官屬，張家口、賽爾烏蘇台站俸餉，烏裡雅蘇台、科布多屯田官兵番換，並各省歲入歲出之數。

translations.literal: The Shanxi section also scrutinized Chahar pasture land tax, Tumet land grain, staff of the Left Deputy Commander-in-Chief at the Border for Khalkha and Muslim regions, postal garrison pay at Zhangjiakou and Sailwusu, rotation of garrison and colonist troops at Uliastai and Kobdo, and each province’s annual revenue and expenditure.
translations.idiomatic: The Shanxi section also audited Chahar pasture tax, Tumet grain, frontier commissioners’ staffs, Zhangjiakou and Sailwusu garrison pay, Uliastai and Kobdo troop rotations, and provincial annual accounts.

sentences.zh: 陝西司兼稽甘肅民賦，行銷鹽引，西安、寧夏、涼州、莊浪各駐防俸餉，並匯覈在京支款，新疆經費。

translations.literal: The Shaanxi section also scrutinized Gansu land tax, salt certificates, garrison pay at Xi’an, Ningxia, Liangzhou, and Zhuanglang, capital disbursements in aggregate, and Xinjiang funds.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaanxi section also audited Gansu land tax, salt certificates, northwestern garrison pay, capital disbursements, and Xinjiang funds.

sentences.zh: 四川司兼稽本省關稅，兩金川等處、新疆屯務，成都駐防俸餉，並京城草廠出納，各部院紙硃支費，入官戶口，贓□銀兩，凡各省郡縣豐歉水旱，歲具其數以上。

translations.literal: The Sichuan section also scrutinized its provincial customs, colonization in the two Jinchuan regions and Xinjiang, Chengdu garrison pay, the capital fodder depot, paper and cinnabar expenses of ministries, registered households and confiscated-fine silver, and reported yearly on each province’s harvest, flood, and drought.
translations.idiomatic: The Sichuan section also audited provincial customs, Jinchuan and Xinjiang colonization, Chengdu garrison pay, the capital fodder depot, ministry stationery costs, registered households and fine silver, and annual provincial harvest reports.

sentences.zh: 廣東司兼稽廣州駐防俸餉，八旗繼嗣戶產更代，凡壽民、孝子、節婦受旌者，給以坊直。

translations.literal: The Guangdong section also scrutinized Guangzhou garrison pay, succession and property transfers among the Eight Banners, and grants for archways to the long-lived, filial sons, and chaste widows whom the court honored.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangdong section also audited Guangzhou garrison pay, Banner succession and property transfers, and archway grants for honored long-lived persons, filial sons, and chaste widows.

sentences.zh: 廣西司兼稽本省礦政廠稅，及京省錢法，內倉出納。

translations.literal: The Guangxi section also scrutinized its mining administration and factory levies, capital coinage regulations, and the inner granaries.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangxi section also audited Guangxi mining and factory levies, capital coinage, and inner granaries.

sentences.zh: 雲南司兼稽本省廠課，山東、河南、江南、江西、浙江、湖廣漕政，京、通倉儲，及江寧水次六倉考覈。

translations.literal: The Yunnan section also scrutinized its factory levies, grain transport in Shandong, Henan, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, and Huguang, capital and Tongzhou granaries, and audit of the six transit granaries at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: The Yunnan section also audited Yunnan factory levies, grain transport in six provinces, capital and Tongzhou granaries, and Nanjing’s six transit granaries.

sentences.zh: 貴州司兼稽各關稅課，並覈貂貢。

translations.literal: The Guizhou section also scrutinized customs duties at the passes and verified sable tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The Guizhou section also audited pass customs and verified sable tribute.

sentences.zh: 所轄內倉監督，滿洲二人。

translations.literal: Over the inner granaries: two Manchu superintendents.
translations.idiomatic: Two Manchu superintendents oversaw the inner granaries.

sentences.zh: 司員內派委。

translations.literal: Assigned by detail from section staff.
translations.idiomatic: They were detailed from section staff.

sentences.zh: 寶泉局監督、各部司員內保送補用。

translations.literal: Baoquan Bureau superintendents were nominated for appointment from section staff of all ministries.
translations.idiomatic: Baoquan superintendents were nominated from ministry section staff.

sentences.zh: 主事，本部司員內派委。

translations.literal: Secretaries were detailed from this ministry’s section staff.
translations.idiomatic: Secretaries were detailed from the ministry’s own section staff.

sentences.zh: 俱滿、漢各一人；

translations.literal: One Manchu and one Han each;
translations.idiomatic: Each had one Manchu and one Han;

sentences.zh: 局大使，東、西、南、北四廠大使，俱滿洲一人。

translations.literal: bureau envoys and envoys of the eastern, western, southern, and northern mints—one Manchu each.
translations.idiomatic: mint envoys for the bureau and for the eastern, western, southern, and northern works—one Manchu each.

sentences.zh: 筆帖式充。

translations.literal: Filled by clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks filled these posts.

sentences.zh: 初置漢一人。

translations.literal: At first one Han was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Initially one Han appointee served.

sentences.zh: 雍正四年增四人，七年改滿洲員缺。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongzheng four were added; in the seventh year the posts became Manchu quota.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 4 four were added; in Yongzheng 7 the posts became Manchu quota.

sentences.zh: 各省錢局監鑄官，十有八人。

translations.literal: Eighteen provincial mint superintendents.
translations.idiomatic: Eighteen provincial mint superintendents served.

sentences.zh: 外官兼充，並受法式法部。

translations.literal: Outside officials served concurrently and received casting standards from the ministry.
translations.idiomatic: Outside officials served concurrently under ministry casting standards.

sentences.zh: 其別領者三：曰井田科，典八旗土田、內府莊戶；

translations.literal: Three separately headed offices: the Land-Tax Section, managing Eight Banner land and imperial estate tenants;
translations.idiomatic: Three separate offices were headed: the Land-Tax Section managed Banner land and imperial estates;

sentences.zh: 曰俸饟處，覈八旗俸饟丁冊；

translations.literal: the Stipend Section, auditing Eight Banner stipend registers;
translations.idiomatic: the Stipend Section audited Banner stipend registers;

sentences.zh: 曰現審處，平八旗戶口田房諍訟。

translations.literal: and the Current Review Section, settling disputes over Banner households, land, and houses.
translations.idiomatic: and the Current Review Section settled Banner household, land, and housing disputes.

sentences.zh: 又飯銀處、減平處、捐納房、監印處、則例館，俱派司屬分治其事。

translations.literal: Also the Meal-Silver Section, Remission Section, Donation Office, Seal-Supervision Office, and Regulations Archive—all had section staff assigned to manage their affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Meal-Silver, Remission, Donation, Seal-Supervision, and Regulations offices likewise had section staff assigned.

sentences.zh: 初，天聰五年，設戶部。

translations.literal: At first, in the fifth year of Tiancong, the Board of Revenue was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Board of Revenue was first set up in Tiancong 5.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，置尚書、侍郎。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi ministers and vice ministers were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 ministers and vice ministers were appointed.

sentences.zh: 右侍郎管錢法堂事。

translations.literal: The right vice minister managed the Coinage Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The right vice minister managed the Coinage Hall.

sentences.zh: 郎中，滿洲十有八人，蒙古四人，康熙三十八年省。

translations.literal: Directors: eighteen Manchus and four Mongols—cut in the thirty-eighth year of Kangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Directors: eighteen Manchus and four Mongols—abolished in Kangxi 38.

sentences.zh: 五十七年復置一人。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year one post was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-seventh year one post was restored.

sentences.zh: 漢軍二人。

translations.literal: Two Han Bannermen.
translations.idiomatic: Two Han Bannermen served.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十八年省。

translations.literal: Cut in the thirty-eighth year of Kangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Abolished in Kangxi 38.

sentences.zh: 員外郎，滿洲三十有八人，蒙古五人，康熙三十八年省，五十七年復置一人。

translations.literal: Vice directors: thirty-eight Manchus and five Mongols—cut in Kangxi 38, one restored in the fifty-seventh year.
translations.idiomatic: Vice directors: thirty-eight Manchus and five Mongols—cut in Kangxi 38, one restored in the fifty-seventh year.

sentences.zh: 漢軍六人。

translations.literal: Six Han Bannermen.
translations.idiomatic: Six Han Bannermen served.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十八年省。

translations.literal: Cut in the thirty-eighth year of Kangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Abolished in Kangxi 38.

sentences.zh: 滿洲堂主事四人，主事十有四人，漢軍堂主事二人。

translations.literal: Four Manchu hall secretaries, fourteen secretaries, two Han Banner hall secretaries.
translations.idiomatic: Four Manchu hall secretaries, fourteen secretaries, and two Han Banner hall secretaries served.

sentences.zh: 十四司，漢郎中、員外郎各一人，主事各三人。

translations.literal: In the fourteen sections: one Han director and vice director each, three secretaries each.
translations.idiomatic: The fourteen sections each had one Han director and vice director and three secretaries.

sentences.zh: 六年，司各增一人。

translations.literal: In the sixth year one post was added per section.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year each section gained one post.

sentences.zh: 十一年省增額。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year the added quota was cut.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year the added posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 康熙六年省江南、浙江、江西、湖廣、福建、河南、陝西、廣西、四川、貴州各一人。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Kangxi one post was cut each in Jiangnan, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Huguang, Fujian, Henan, Shaanxi, Guangxi, Sichuan, and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 6 one post was cut in each of ten sections.

sentences.zh: 三十八年省山東、山西、廣東、雲南各一人。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year one was cut each in Shandong, Shanxi, Guangdong, and Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year one post was cut in Shandong, Shanxi, Guangdong, and Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 五年，定滿、漢尚書各一人。

translations.literal: In the fifth year one Manchu and one Han minister each were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year one Manchu and one Han minister each were appointed.

sentences.zh: 七年增滿洲一人，十年省。

translations.literal: In the seventh year one Manchu was added; in the tenth year cut.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year one Manchu was added; in the tenth it was abolished.

sentences.zh: 康熙六年復置，八年又省。

translations.literal: Restored in Kangxi 6, cut again in Kangxi 8.
translations.idiomatic: Restored in Kangxi 6 and abolished again in Kangxi 8.

sentences.zh: 康熙五十七年，增置福建司蒙古主事一人。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 57 one Mongolian secretary was added to the Fujian section.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 57 the Fujian section gained one Mongolian secretary.

sentences.zh: 雍正初，始令親王、大學士領部事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongzheng princes and grand secretaries were first ordered to head the ministry.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Yongzheng princes and grand secretaries were first ordered to head the ministry.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，以川省用兵，銷算務劇，復令親王永瑆綜之。

translations.literal: In Jiaqing 4, with war in Sichuan and heavy settlement work, Prince Yongxing was again ordered to oversee it.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4, with Sichuan campaigns and heavy accounts, Prince Yongxing was again ordered to oversee the ministry.

sentences.zh: 尋罷。

translations.literal: Soon removed.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon removed.

sentences.zh: 並改滿洲郎中一人、員外郎二人為宗室員缺。

translations.literal: One Manchu director and two vice directors were also changed to Imperial Clan quota.
translations.idiomatic: One Manchu director and two vice directors also became Imperial Clan quota posts.

sentences.zh: 十一年，仍令大學士管部。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year grand secretaries again managed the ministry.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year grand secretaries again managed the ministry.

sentences.zh: 光緒六年，增浙江司宗室主事一人。

translations.literal: In Guangxu 6 one Imperial Clan secretary was added to the Zhejiang section.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 6 the Zhejiang section gained one Imperial Clan secretary.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，更名度支部。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year it was renamed the Metrics Section.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year it was renamed the Metrics Section.

sentences.zh: 初制，按省分職，十三司外，增設江南一司，凡銅、關、鹽、漕，及續建行省，別以司之事簡領之。

translations.literal: In the initial system duties were divided by province; beyond thirteen sections a Jiangnan section was added, and copper, customs, salt, grain transport, and newly established provinces were assigned to sections according to the lightness of their workload.
translations.idiomatic: Initially duties were divided by province; beyond thirteen sections a Jiangnan section was added, with lighter sections taking copper, customs, salt, transport, and new provinces.

sentences.zh: 管理三庫大臣，滿、漢各一人，三年請旨更派。

translations.literal: Ministers managing the Three Treasuries—one Manchu and one Han each—reassigned every three years by imperial order.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Treasuries were directed by one Manchu and one Han minister each, reassigned every three years by imperial order.

sentences.zh: 掌庫藏出納，月會歲要，覈實以聞。

translations.literal: They managed treasury receipts and disbursements, monthly and annual accounts, verified and reported to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: They managed treasury receipts and disbursements, compiled monthly and annual accounts, verified them, and reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 其屬：檔房主事一人，銀、緞疋、顏料三庫郎中各一人，員外郎各二人，司庫五人，正七品。

translations.literal: Subordinates: one archives secretary; one director each for the silver, silk-bolt, and pigment treasuries; two vice directors each; five warehouse custodians, regular seventh grade.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinates included one archives secretary; one director each for the silver, silk-bolt, and pigment treasuries; two vice directors apiece; and five warehouse custodians of regular seventh grade.

sentences.zh: 銀庫一人，餘各二人。

translations.literal: One for the silver treasury, two each for the rest.
translations.idiomatic: The silver treasury had one; the others had two each.

sentences.zh: 大使四人，銀庫二人，餘各一人。

translations.literal: Four envoys—two for the silver treasury, one each for the rest.
translations.idiomatic: There were four envoys: two for the silver treasury and one each for the others.

sentences.zh: 各部司員內補授。

translations.literal: Filled by internal appointment from section members of the ministries.
translations.idiomatic: They were appointed from ministry section members already in service.

sentences.zh: 筆帖式四人，庫使十有一人。

translations.literal: Four clerks and eleven treasury attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Four clerks and eleven treasury attendants served.

sentences.zh: 未入流。

translations.literal: Outside the regular ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Their posts lay outside the regular bureaucracy.

sentences.zh: 以上俱為滿缺。

translations.literal: All the above were Manchu-quota posts.
translations.idiomatic: All of the above were Manchu-quota posts.

sentences.zh: 順治初，設後庫，在部署。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi, a rear treasury was established within the ministry compound.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi a rear treasury was set up in the ministry compound.

sentences.zh: 置郎中四人，員外郎二人。

translations.literal: Four directors and two vice directors were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Four directors and two vice directors were appointed.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十九年定三庫俱各一人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year of Kangxi, each of the three treasuries was fixed at one each.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 29 each of the three treasuries was limited to one apiece.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年增員外郎各一人。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng one vice director was added to each.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 2 one vice director was added to each treasury.

sentences.zh: 十三年，分建三庫，改後庫為銀庫。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, the three treasuries were built separately and the rear treasury was renamed the silver treasury.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year the three treasuries were split into separate sites and the rear treasury became the silver treasury.

sentences.zh: 緞疋庫在東華門外，即舊裡新庫。

translations.literal: The silk-bolt treasury stood outside Donghua Gate—that is, the old Lixin Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: The silk-bolt treasury stood outside Donghua Gate, the former Lixin Treasury.

sentences.zh: 顏料庫在西安門內，即舊甲字庫。

translations.literal: The pigment treasury stood inside Xi'an Gate—that is, the old Jiazi Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: The pigment treasury stood inside Xi'an Gate, the former Jiazi Treasury.

sentences.zh: 置理事官綜其事。

translations.literal: Managing officials were appointed to oversee the whole.
translations.idiomatic: Managing officials were appointed to coordinate affairs.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，改命王公大臣領之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, princes and grand ministers were ordered to head them instead.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 princes and grand ministers were ordered to take charge.

sentences.zh: 明年，置大使各一人，乾隆三年增銀庫一人。

translations.literal: The following year one envoy was appointed to each; in the third year of Qianlong the silver treasury gained one more.
translations.idiomatic: The next year each treasury received one envoy; in Qianlong 3 the silver treasury gained a second.

sentences.zh: 並增主事一人，稽覈檔案。

translations.literal: One secretary was also added to audit the archives.
translations.idiomatic: One secretary was also added to audit the archives.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十八年省。

translations.literal: Abolished in the twenty-eighth year of Guangxu.
translations.idiomatic: Abolished in Guangxu 28.

sentences.zh: 總督倉場侍郎，滿、漢各一人，分駐通州新城。

translations.literal: Vice ministers supervising the granaries and transport, one Manchu and one Han each, were stationed separately at Tongzhou and Xincheng.
translations.idiomatic: The vice ministers supervising granaries and transport—one Manchu and one Han each—were posted separately at Tongzhou and Xincheng.

sentences.zh: 掌倉穀委積，北河運務。

translations.literal: They managed stored grain and the transport duties of the Northern River.
translations.idiomatic: They managed grain reserves and Northern River transport duties.

sentences.zh: 其屬：筆帖式四人。

translations.literal: Subordinates: four clerks.
translations.idiomatic: They had four clerks among their subordinates.

sentences.zh: 所轄坐糧□，滿、漢各一人，滿員由六部、理籓院郎員，漢員由六部郎員內簡用。

translations.literal: Under their authority was the Grain Receipt Office (□), one Manchu and one Han each; Manchu posts were drawn from directors of the six ministries and the Court of Colonial Affairs, Han posts from directors of the six ministries.
translations.idiomatic: They oversaw the Grain Receipt Office (□), one Manchu and one Han each: Manchus were chosen from directors of the six ministries and the Court of Colonial Affairs, Han officials from directors of the six ministries.

sentences.zh: 掌轉運輸倉，及通濟庫出納。

translations.literal: They managed transfer and transport granaries and receipts and disbursements of the Tongji Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: They managed transfer and transport granaries and the receipts and disbursements of the Tongji Treasury.

sentences.zh: 大通橋監督，滿、漢各一人，十一倉監督內補用。

translations.literal: Supervisors of Datong Bridge, one Manchu and one Han each, were filled from among the eleven granary supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisors of Datong Bridge, one Manchu and one Han each, were drawn from the eleven granary supervisors.

sentences.zh: 掌轉大通陸運。

translations.literal: They managed overland transport via Datong.
translations.idiomatic: They managed overland transport through Datong.

sentences.zh: 十一倉監督，曰祿米、曰南新、曰舊太、曰富新、曰興平、曰海運、曰北新、曰太平，俱清初建。

translations.literal: The eleven granary supervisors were: Lumii, Nanxin, Jiutai, Fuxin, Xingping, Haiyun, Beixin, and Taiping—all built at the beginning of the dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven granary supervisors oversaw Lumii, Nanxin, Jiutai, Fuxin, Xingping, Haiyun, Beixin, and Taiping granaries—all founded early in the dynasty.

sentences.zh: 曰本裕，康熙四十五年建。
