translations.idiomatic: Each had one director and one Han director; the Zhili Section had two Manchu vice directors and one Mongol.

sentences.zh: 漢三人，奉天司一人，直隸司二人。

translations.literal: Han three—one for the Fengtian Section, two for the Zhili Section.
translations.idiomatic: There were three Han posts—one in Fengtian and two in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 滿、漢主事俱各一人，是為十七司。

translations.literal: One Manchu and one Han secretary each—making seventeen sections in all.
translations.idiomatic: One Manchu and one Han secretary served each section, for seventeen sections in all.

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing, with a grand secretary heading ministry affairs, one Manchu director, vice director, and secretary each were changed to Imperial Clan quota posts.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4 a grand secretary headed the ministry, and one Manchu director, vice director, and secretary each became Imperial Clan quota posts.

sentences.zh: 光緒六年，增置雲南司宗室員外郎一人。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Guangxu, one Imperial Clan vice director was added to the Yunnan Section.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 6 one Imperial Clan vice director was added to the Yunnan Section.

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year, renamed the Ministry of Law.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year it took the name Ministry of Law.

sentences.zh: 工部尚書，左、右侍郎，俱滿、漢一人。

translations.idiomatic: Subordinates included chancery secretaries; three Manchu archive clerks and one Manchu and one Han Banner clerk each for the Chinese archive.

sentences.zh: 司務□司務，滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: Registry managers—one Manchu and one Han.
translations.idiomatic: Registry managers—one Manchu and one Han.

translations.literal: Fair-copy clerks: one Imperial Clan member and ten Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: Fair-copy clerks included one Imperial Clan member and ten Manchus.

translations.idiomatic: Vice ministers assisted him.

translations.literal: The right vice minister also managed coin casting at the Bao Source Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: The right vice minister also ran coin casting at the Bao Source Bureau.

translations.idiomatic: Forests and Stores oversaw mountain and marsh collection and hunting and the smelting of manufactures.

translations.idiomatic: Colonies handled major tomb works and regulations for princely, noble, and official burials.

translations.idiomatic: It supplied fuel and charcoal for great sacrifices and annual allotments to other offices;

translations.idiomatic: It also oversaw craftsmen and audited sea, reed, and coal levies.

sentences.zh: 節慎掌主帑藏，司出納。

translations.literal: Frugal-Care managed the treasury stores and controlled receipts and disbursements.
translations.idiomatic: Frugal-Care kept treasury stores and handled receipts and disbursements.

translations.idiomatic: for chariots, regalia, and ceremonial guards it gathered materials and coordinated with the Imperial Procession Guard.

translations.idiomatic: They were nominated from the ministry’s clerks.

translations.idiomatic: Its duties matched the Bao Fountain Bureau.

translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Timber Yard, glazed-tile kilns, timber warehouses, military supplies office, official carriage depot, fuel depot, icehouses, and silk-collection depot each had one Manchu and one Han superintendent.

translations.idiomatic: The materials-estimate office likewise had two Manchu and two Han section officials.

sentences.zh: 黃檔房無定員。

translations.literal: Yellow-archive office: no fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: The yellow-archive office had no fixed number of posts.

sentences.zh: 以上各員，並由本部司員內選用。

translations.literal: All the above were chosen from this ministry’s section officials.
translations.idiomatic: All of the above were chosen from this ministry’s section officials.

translations.idiomatic: The Board of Works was first established in Tiancong 5.

translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 minister and vice-minister posts were created.

translations.idiomatic: The right vice minister also oversaw coinage.
